subject: general
question:
Select the pair that follows the same pattern as the one followed by the two pairs given below. Both pairs follow the same pattern.

JGF−GDC

FCB−CZY
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/06181392e9897efb4b81331befbf0235a23822489dcd574e6efffefb8787d3bd.png] 

Logic followed here is: The second group of letters is determined by shifting each letter of the first group 3 positions backward in the alphabetical order.

**For**

**JGF is related to GDC →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cce43cf7575971be7d0aa813ebf2fe47fc2ac7ec07b32fa3262b99fa0432dfc.png] 

 

**FCB is related to CZY →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99564e3ed08badddb0be39e28800bfc5c41875ffc0715f5458bc67cd705bd822.png] 

**Similarly, Option 2) BYX − YVU:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65f74e8db3c086df0224e43ba8f08851461fdbfaed09deedbe5efc3fc1610bc4.png] 

Therefore, the pair that follows the same pattern is 'BYX − YVU'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
